title_en: Fall 2026 Graduate Thesis Qualifying Examination: Schedule and Registration
summary: Master's and doctoral students in their second registered semester, and integrated master's-doctoral students in their third registered semester, in Fall 2026 sit the written Thesis Qualifying Examination on Friday, 11 September 2026, 10:00–12:00; the room will be announced by SNU email. To register, students must complete online registration on the SNU portal between 18 August 2026, 10:00, and 2 September 2026, 23:59. They must also submit four documents in person at the Department Office (Building 301, Room 319) within the deadline; registration is complete only when both steps are done.
applies_to: Graduate students of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부): master's and doctoral students who will be in their 2nd registered semester in Fall 2026 (2026-2학기), and integrated master's-doctoral students who will be in their 3rd registered semester in Fall 2026. The notice marks the examination as compulsory ('must take') on the integrated master's-doctoral line. To be eligible, a student must meet all of these: at least 6 credits of the department's graduate courses (with the exclusions listed in the notice); a passed English requirement; the initial Environmental Safety training; and the Human Rights/Gender Equality training. The Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) training is also required for students admitted from the 2016 academic year onward. The registration requirement is at least 2 registered semesters for master's and doctoral students and at least 3 for integrated master's-doctoral students. Foreign students who are nationals of an English-speaking country (where English is the native, common or official language) must take the Korean language test.

Earliest time candidates may leave the examination room
dates.when: From one hour after the exam starts

dates.what: Online registration on the SNU portal (the schedule may change)
Tuition payment deadline; the fee must be paid within the regular registration period (no dates are given in the notice)
Initial Environmental Safety training, for students who have not completed it

conditions: Registration is complete only when both the online registration and the in-person document submission are done.
If any of the four required documents is not submitted within the deadline, registration for the examination is not accepted.
If tuition is not paid within the regular registration period, the student does not meet the eligibility requirement and cannot be judged to have passed, and no remedy is available.
All examination information is sent only to the snu.ac.kr email address registered in MySNU basic information, not to Naver, Gmail or other addresses.
The online registration schedule may change.
No one may enter the room after the exam starts; candidates may leave only from one hour after the start.
Candidates answer 2 subjects, chosen in the examination room after receiving the question paper; subjects are not selected during registration, and the full syllabus is covered.
Each subject is marked out of 100, and the average of the two subjects must reach the pass mark: 60 for master's students, 70 for doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral students.
Candidates must bring photo identification (a student ID card is acceptable).
Calculators are allowed but may not be shared during the exam.
Only pens may be used; pencils are not allowed. Candidates may keep the question paper.
The photo on the admission ticket must be the same as the photo on the application form.

For safety training, only the initial training (신규교육) certificate in A4 size is accepted; the regular training (정기교육, 6 hours) does not qualify, and students holding only that certificate cannot take the exam.
The Life Respect training needs to be completed only once, during either undergraduate or graduate study.
Excluded from the 6-credit requirement: thesis research, S/U courses, lecture-style modular master's/doctoral seminars (listed in attachment 3), and credits transferred between programs.
The English requirement is usually met by the score submitted at admission; if it shows as failed, contact the department office and submit an additional English score.
Foreign students who are nationals of an English-speaking country must take the Korean language test; other foreign students may either submit an English score or take the Korean language test.
Passing the doctoral Thesis Qualifying Examination is required to be eligible for the doctoral dissertation preliminary review.
The oral examination was abolished after Spring 2024; pass or fail is decided by the written exam only.
Integrated master's-doctoral students should see the retake rules at the link in the notice.
To cancel after registering, contact the department office by email (contact details are in the original notice).
steps: Check the snu.ac.kr email address registered in MySNU basic information regularly; the examination room and all other information will be sent there.

Confirm your eligibility: at least 6 eligible credits, completed trainings, and your English result at MySNU > 학사정보 > 졸업 > 졸업시험신청 > 종합시험 판정결과 조회 > 영어. If English shows as failed, contact the department office and submit an additional English score.
Foreign students: read the department's notice on foreign language tests to register for the Korean language test if required.
Complete the Human Rights/Gender Equality training on the Human Rights Center online system (https://helplms.snu.ac.kr) and download the certificate online.
Complete the initial Environmental Safety training: apply online, attend the offline training, then download the A4 certificate online.

If you have not completed the Life Respect training, apply within the deadline following the 'Life Respect Education' (생명존중교육 안내) notice posted on the academic board in August, then download the certificate online.
Pay tuition within the regular registration period (본등록기간).

Register online between 18 August 2026, 10:00, and 2 September 2026, 23:59 at Portal > 학사행정 > 졸업 > 졸업시험신청 > 종합시험신청. Select Major (전공) 'Take' (응시) and Second Foreign Language (제2외국어) 'Not taking' (미응시). For Korean (한국어), select 'Take' (응시) only if you are a foreign student taking the Korean language test; otherwise select 'Not taking' (미응시). Upload all three training certificates as attachments.
Print the application form with your registration number from the portal and obtain your supervisor's seal (stamp); make sure its photo matches your admission ticket photo.

Submit the four documents at the Department Office (Building 301, Room 319) within the deadline: the application form, the Human Rights/Gender Equality certificate, the initial Environmental Safety training certificate and the Life Respect training certificate.
Optionally study past papers at https://ee.snu.ac.kr/intranet > 정보서비스 > 양식&문서 > 논문제출자격시험(논자시) 기출 문제 (log in with your old intranet ID; if you have none, contact the department office).
On 11 September 2026, enter the room by 9:50 with photo ID, a pen and, if wanted, your own calculator. Check the seating chart posted at the room entrance and sit in your assigned seat.
Check your result in October 2026 at MySNU > 학사정보 > 졸업 > 졸업시험 신청 > 종합시험 판정결과 조회.
translation:
★Fall 2026 Graduate Thesis Qualifying Examination Schedule

All information about the examination will be sent separately to registrants by email. You must check the snu.ac.kr email address registered in your MySNU basic information at all times. (We do not contact students at Naver, Gmail or other addresses.)

1. Examination schedule
- Date and time: Friday, 11 September 2026, 10:00–12:00 (2 hours). You must enter the room by 9:50.
  ※ No entry after the exam starts. You may leave from one hour after the start.
- Location: to be announced later to registrants (by SNU email).

2. Who takes the exam
- Master's and doctoral programs: students who will be in their 2nd registered semester in Fall 2026.
- Integrated master's-doctoral program: students who will be in their 3rd registered semester in Fall 2026 must take the exam!!!
  ※ Retake rules for the integrated master's-doctoral program: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=55871

3. Important notes
A. You must complete tuition payment during the regular registration period (본등록기간).
  ※ If you do not register within the regular registration period, you will not meet the eligibility requirement and cannot be judged to have passed the exam, and there is no additional remedy.
B. Number of written exam subjects: 2. On the exam day, you choose 2 subjects after receiving the question paper in the room. There is no procedure for selecting subjects during registration.
  ※ The full syllabus is covered.
C. Pass criteria: each subject is marked out of 100. The average of the two subjects must be at or above the pass mark.
  ① Master's: 60 or more out of 100.
  ② Doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral: 70 or more out of 100.
D. Past papers: https://ee.snu.ac.kr/intranet > 정보서비스 > go to the 양식&문서 tab > 논문제출자격시험(논자시) 기출 문제
  ※ You must log in with your old intranet ID. Students without an ID should contact the staff member named in the original notice (contact details in the original notice).
E. On the exam day: check the seating chart posted at the entrance of the room and sit in your assigned seat.
F. What to bring: you must bring photo identification (a student ID card is acceptable). Calculators are allowed, but you may not share a calculator during the exam.
  ※ You may take the question paper with you. Only pens may be used (no pencils).
G. Details: see the attachment (to be uploaded soon). The attachments were not read for this translation.

4. How to register: online registration (portal) > visit the department office to submit documents. You must complete both to be registered.
A. Online registration (portal)
  - 18 August 2026 (Tue) 10:00 to 2 September 2026 (Wed) 23:59. ※ This schedule may change.
  - Apply at Portal > 학사행정 > 졸업 > 졸업시험신청 > 종합시험신청.
    ※ Under comprehensive exam subject categories, select Major (전공) – 'Take' (응시); Second Foreign Language (제2외국어) – 'Not taking' (미응시); Korean (한국어) – 'Take' (응시) if you are a foreign student who will take the Korean language test, otherwise 'Not taking' (미응시).
  - You must upload all three training certificates as attachments.
B. Visit the department office to submit documents (4 in total). If the documents below are not submitted within the deadline, you cannot register for the exam.
  1) Application form: after online registration, you can print the application form with your registration number. Obtain your supervisor's seal (stamp) and submit it. ※ The photo on the admission ticket must be the same as the photo on the application form.
  2) Human Rights/Gender Equality Education certificate: can be issued online immediately on completion. Complete it on the Human Rights Center online education system (https://helplms.snu.ac.kr).
  3) Environmental Safety initial training (신규교육) certificate: apply online > complete the offline training > the certificate can be issued online.
    ※ Only the initial training certificate is accepted (A4-size certificates only). The regular training (정기교육, 6 hours) does not qualify (you cannot take the exam with it). Students who have not completed Environmental Safety training must attend the initial training in February.
  4) Life Respect Education certificate: can be issued online immediately on completion. It needs to be taken only once during undergraduate or graduate study.
    ※ Students who have not completed it must apply within the deadline, following the 'Life Respect Education' (생명존중교육 안내) notice posted on the academic board in August.
* If you wish to cancel after registering, please contact the staff member in charge by email (contact details in the original notice).

5. Eligibility
1) Master's
- Completed at least 6 credits of graduate courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. *Excluded: ① thesis research ② S/U courses ③ lecture-style modular master's/doctoral seminars (see attachment 3) ④ credits transferred between programs.
- Passed the English requirement (usually met by the score submitted at admission; if failed, contact the staff member in charge and submit an additional English score).
  ※ You must check whether English is recognised as passed at 'Mysnu > 학사정보 > 졸업 > 졸업시험신청 > 종합시험 판정결과 조회 > 영어'!
  ※ Foreign students who are nationals of an English-speaking country (English as native, common or official language) must take the Korean language test. Other foreign students either submit an English score or take the Korean language test.
- Registered for at least 2 semesters and completed the Environmental Safety training organised by the Environmental Safety Institute.
  ※ This means the Environmental Safety initial training. The regular training (6 hours) does not count.
- Completed the Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) training (for students admitted from the 2016 academic year onward) and the Human Rights/Gender Equality training.
2) Doctoral
- Same requirements as for the master's program: at least 6 eligible credits (same exclusions), a passed English requirement (same checking and nationality rules), at least 2 registered semesters with completed Environmental Safety initial training (not the 6-hour regular training), Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) training (admitted from 2016 onward) and Human Rights/Gender Equality training.
3) Integrated master's-doctoral
- Same as above, except: registered for at least 3 semesters and completed the Environmental Safety initial training (the 6-hour regular training does not count).

6. Additional information
- Results: announced during October 2026 (check on MySNU: Mysnu > 학사정보 > 졸업 > 졸업시험 신청 > 종합시험 판정결과 조회).
- Korean language test registration for foreign students: you must read the notice on foreign language tests.
- Eligibility for the doctoral dissertation preliminary review: students who have passed the doctoral Thesis Qualifying Examination.
- Oral examination abolished: the oral examination was abolished after Spring 2024 (held March 2024). Pass or fail is decided by the written exam.

7. Enquiries
- Department Office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff contact is given in the original notice.

2. Graduate Thesis Qualifying Examination course table (HWP)
3. Thesis Qualifying Examination total and itemised scores (HWP)
4. List of lecture-style modular master's and doctoral seminars (HWP)
